question: Shepherd à¨¦à©‡ à¨“à¨µà¨°  19-20  à¨µà¨¿à¨š à¨¬à©±à¨²à©‡à¨¬à¨¾à©›à©€ à¨¦à©‡ à¨†à¨‚à¨•à©œà©‡  à¨¦à©±à¨¸à©‹  (à¨°à¨¨ , à¨—à©‡à¨‚à¨¦à¨¾ , à¨†à¨Šà¨Ÿ , à¨¸à¨¤à©à¨°à©€à¨•à©‡ à¨°à©‡à¨Ÿ , à¨šà©Œà¨•à©‡ à¨¤à©‡ à¨›à¨•à©‡ )à¥¤

SELECT
  SUM(T1.runs_scored) AS "Runs",
  COUNT(T1.delivery_id) AS "Balls",
  SUM(CASE WHEN T1.player_out_id = T2.player_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "Dismissals",
  SUM(CASE WHEN T1.runs_scored = 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "Fours",
  SUM(CASE WHEN T1.runs_scored = 6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "Sixes",
  CAST(SUM(T1.runs_scored) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T1.delivery_id) AS "Strike_Rate"
FROM Deliveries AS T1
INNER JOIN Players AS T2
  ON T1.striker_id = T2.player_id
WHERE
  T2.player_name LIKE 'R Shepherd%' AND T1.over_number >= 18 AND NOT (
    T1.extra_runs > 0 AND T1.runs_scored = 0 AND T1.wicket_type IS NULL
  );

question: List all batsmen with at least 1000 runs against any team in ipl.
query:
SELECT
  "striker",
  CASE
    WHEN "bowling_team" = 'Deccan Chargers'
    OR "bowling_team" = 'Sunrisers Hyderabad' THEN 'Hyderabad'
    WHEN "bowling_team" = 'Delhi Daredevils'
    OR "bowling_team" = 'Delhi Capitals' THEN 'Delhi'
    WHEN "bowling_team" = 'Kings XI Punjab'
    OR "bowling_team" = 'Punjab Kings' THEN 'Punjab'
    WHEN "bowling_team" = 'Pune Warriors'
    OR "bowling_team" = 'Rising Pune Supergiant'
    OR "bowling_team" = 'Rising Pune Supergiants' THEN 'Pune'
    ELSE "bowling_team"
  END AS Opponent,
  SUM("runs_scored") AS TotalRuns
FROM "Deliveries"
GROUP BY
  "striker",
  Opponent
HAVING
  SUM("runs_scored") >= 1000
ORDER BY
  TotalRuns DESC;

INNER JOIN Matches AS T2

query:
WITH MI_Playoff_Innings AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    T1.match_id,
    T2.inning
  FROM Matches AS T1
  INNER JOIN Deliveries AS T2
    ON T1.match_id = T2.match_id
  WHERE
    T1.stage <> 'Group' AND T2.batting_team = 'Mumbai Indians'
), First_Wicket_Deliveries AS (
  SELECT
    match_id,
    inning,
    MIN(delivery_id) AS first_wicket_delivery
  FROM Deliveries
  WHERE
    player_out_id IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY
    match_id,
    inning
), Opening_Partnerships AS (
  SELECT
    T1.match_id,
    T1.inning,
    SUM(T3.runs_scored + T3.extra_runs) AS partnership_runs
  FROM MI_Playoff_Innings AS T1
  LEFT JOIN First_Wicket_Deliveries AS T2
    ON T1.match_id = T2.match_id AND T1.inning = T2.inning
  INNER JOIN Deliveries AS T3
    ON T1.match_id = T3.match_id AND T1.inning = T3.inning
  WHERE
    T3.delivery_id < T2.first_wicket_delivery OR T2.first_wicket_delivery IS NULL
  GROUP BY
    T1.match_id,
    T1.inning
), Opening_Batsmen AS (
  SELECT
    match_id,
    inning,
    striker_id,
    non_striker_id
  FROM Deliveries
  WHERE
    over_number = 0 AND ball_number = 1
)
SELECT
  p1.player_name AS "Batsman 1",
  p2.player_name AS "Batsman 2",
  op.partnership_runs AS "Partnership Runs",
  CASE WHEN m.team1 = 'Mumbai Indians' THEN m.team2 ELSE m.team1 END AS "Opponent",
  m.match_date AS "Match Date"
FROM Opening_Partnerships AS op
INNER JOIN Opening_Batsmen AS ob
  ON op.match_id = ob.match_id AND op.inning = ob.inning
INNER JOIN Matches AS m
  ON op.match_id = m.match_id
INNER JOIN Players AS p1
  ON ob.striker_id = p1.player_id
INNER JOIN Players AS p2
  ON ob.non_striker_id = p2.player_id
ORDER BY
  "Partnership Runs" DESC
LIMIT 5;

question: Show MIâ€™s IPL playoff record when batting first and when fielding first.
query:
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN (T1.toss_winner = 'Mumbai Indians' AND T1.toss_decision = 'bat') OR (T1.toss_winner <> 'Mumbai Indians' AND T1.toss_decision = 'field')
    THEN 'Batting First'
    ELSE 'Fielding First'
  END AS "MI_Action",
  COUNT(T1.match_id) AS "Matches_Played",
  SUM(CASE WHEN T1.match_winner = 'Mumbai Indians' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "Wins",
  SUM(CASE WHEN T1.match_winner <> 'Mumbai Indians' AND T1.match_winner IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "Losses"
FROM "Matches" AS T1
WHERE
  (T1.team1 = 'Mumbai Indians' OR T1.team2 = 'Mumbai Indians') AND T1.stage <> 'Group'
GROUP BY
  "MI_Action";
generated_sql:
SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN m.team1 = 'MI' AND m.toss_winner = 'MI' AND m.toss_decision = 'bat' THEN 'Batting First'
        WHEN m.team2 = 'MI' AND m.toss_winner = 'MI' AND m.toss_decision = 'bat' THEN 'Batting First'
        WHEN m.team1 = 'MI' AND m.toss_winner = 'MI' AND m.toss_decision = 'field' THEN 'Fielding First'
        WHEN m.team2 = 'MI' AND m.toss_winner = 'MI' AND m.toss_decision = 'field' THEN 'Fielding First'
        WHEN m.team1 = 'MI' AND m.toss_winner != 'MI' AND m.toss_decision = 'field' THEN 'Fielding First'
        WHEN m.team2 = 'MI' AND m.toss_winner != 'MI' AND m.toss_decision = 'field' THEN 'Fielding First'
        WHEN m.team1 = 'MI' AND m.toss_winner != 'MI' AND m.toss_decision = 'bat' THEN 'Batting First'
        WHEN m.team2 = 'MI' AND m.toss_winner != 'MI' AND m.toss_decision = 'bat' THEN 'Batting First'
    END AS innings_decision,
    COUNT(*) AS matches_played,
    SUM(CASE WHEN m.match_winner = 'MI' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS matches_won,
    SUM(CASE WHEN m.match_winner != 'MI' AND m.match_winner IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS matches_lost,
    SUM(CASE WHEN m.result_type = 'tie' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ties,
    SUM(CASE WHEN m.match_winner IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS no_result
FROM Matches m
WHERE m.stage != 'Group' 
  AND (m.team1 = 'MI' OR m.team2 = 'MI')
GROUP BY innings_decision;

question: Show teams that used the same top three batters in all league matches of an IPL season.
query:
WITH BattingOrder AS (
  SELECT
    T1."match_id",
    T1."batting_team",
    T1."striker_id",
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY T1."match_id", T1."batting_team" ORDER BY T1.first_ball_faced) AS batting_position
  FROM (
    SELECT
      "match_id",
      "batting_team",
      "striker_id",
      MIN("delivery_id") AS first_ball_faced
    FROM "Deliveries"
    GROUP BY
      "match_id",
      "batting_team",
      "striker_id"
  ) AS T1
), MatchTop3Lineup AS (
  SELECT
    M."season",
    B."batting_team",
    GROUP_CONCAT(B."striker_id" ORDER BY B.batting_position) AS top_3_batters
  FROM BattingOrder AS B
  JOIN "Matches" AS M
    ON B.match_id = M.match_id
  WHERE
    B.batting_position <= 3 AND M."stage" = 'Group'
  GROUP BY
    M."season",
    B.match_id,
    B."batting_team"
  HAVING
    COUNT(B."striker_id") = 3
)
SELECT
  "season",
  "batting_team"
FROM MatchTop3Lineup
GROUP BY
  "season",
  "batting_team"
HAVING
  COUNT(DISTINCT top_3_batters) = 1 AND COUNT(*) > 1
ORDER BY
  "season" DESC
LIMIT 5;
generated_sql:
WITH LeagueMatches AS (
    SELECT match_id, season, team1 AS team_name FROM Matches WHERE stage = 'Group'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT match_id, season, team2 AS team_name FROM Matches WHERE stage = 'Group'
),
BatterRanks AS (
    SELECT
        lm.team_name,
        lm.season,
        d.striker_id,
        SUM(d.runs_scored) AS total_runs,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY lm.team_name, lm.season ORDER BY SUM(d.runs_scored) DESC) AS rn
    FROM LeagueMatches lm
    JOIN Deliveries d ON lm.match_id = d.match_id AND lm.team_name = d.batting_team
    GROUP BY lm.team_name, lm.season, d.striker_id
),
TopThreeBatters AS (
    SELECT team_name, season, striker_id
    FROM BatterRanks
    WHERE rn <= 3
),
TeamSeasonTopThree AS (
    SELECT
        team_name,
        season,
        GROUP_CONCAT(striker_id, ',') AS top_three_batters
    FROM TopThreeBatters
    GROUP BY team_name, season
)
SELECT DISTINCT team_name
FROM TeamSeasonTopThree t1
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM TeamSeasonTopThree t2
    WHERE t2.team_name = t1.team_name
      AND t2.season != t1.season
      AND t2.top_three_batters != t1.top_three_batters
);

question: Show Virat Kohliâ€™s overall batting record against PBKS in IPL â€” matches, runs, average, strike rate, centuries, and fifties.
query:
WITH KohliMatchRuns AS (
  SELECT
    T1."match_id",
    SUM(T1."runs_scored") AS runs,
    COUNT(T1."delivery_id") AS balls
  FROM "Deliveries" AS T1
  WHERE
    T1."striker_id" = (
      SELECT
        "player_id"
      FROM "Players"
      WHERE
        "player_name" = 'V Kohli'
    ) AND T1."bowling_team" IN ('Kings XI Punjab', 'Punjab Kings')
  GROUP BY
    T1."match_id"
), KohliDismissals AS (
  SELECT
    COUNT(T1."delivery_id") AS dismissals
  FROM "Deliveries" AS T1
  WHERE
    T1."player_out_id" = (
      SELECT
        "player_id"
      FROM "Players"
      WHERE
        "player_name" = 'V Kohli'
    ) AND T1."bowling_team" IN ('Kings XI Punjab', 'Punjab Kings')
)

  COUNT(T1."match_id") AS "Matches",
  SUM(T1.runs) AS "Runs",
  CAST(SUM(T1.runs) AS REAL) / T2.dismissals AS "Average",
  CAST(SUM(T1.runs) AS REAL) * 100 / SUM(T1.balls) AS "Strike Rate",
  SUM(CASE WHEN T1.runs >= 100 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "Centuries",
  SUM(CASE WHEN T1.runs >= 50 AND T1.runs < 100 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "Fifties"

question: Find the top 5 players with the highest strike rates who scored atleast 400 runs in an ipl season.
query:
SELECT
  T3."player_name",
  T2."season",
  SUM(T1."runs_scored") AS "total_runs",
  CAST(SUM(T1."runs_scored") AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(
    CASE
      WHEN T1."extra_runs" = 0
      OR T1."runs_scored" > 0
      OR T1."wicket_type" IS NOT NULL THEN 1
    END
  ) AS "strike_rate"
FROM "Deliveries" AS T1
INNER JOIN "Matches" AS T2
  ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id"
INNER JOIN "Players" AS T3
  ON T1."striker_id" = T3."player_id"
GROUP BY
  T3."player_name",
  T2."season"
HAVING
  SUM(T1."runs_scored") >= 400
ORDER BY
  "strike_rate" DESC
LIMIT 5;
generated_sql:
SELECT 
    p.player_name,
    d.strike_rate
FROM (
    SELECT 
        d.striker_id,
        m.season,
        SUM(d.runs_scored) AS total_runs,
        COUNT(*) AS total_balls,
        CAST(SUM(d.runs_scored) AS FLOAT) * 100 / COUNT(*) AS strike_rate
    FROM Deliveries d
    JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id

question: what is the highest partnership for RCB for 5th wicket or lower in a run-chase.Give the batsman involved with the partnership.
query:
WITH WicketEvents AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "over_number",
    "ball_number",
    "striker_id",
    "non_striker_id",
    "runs_scored" + "extra_runs" AS "total_runs",
    CASE WHEN "player_out_id" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS "is_wicket"
  FROM "Deliveries"
  WHERE
    "inning" = 2 AND "batting_team" IN ('Royal Challengers Bangalore', 'Royal Challengers Bengaluru')
), PartnershipGroups AS (
  SELECT
    T1."match_id",
    T1."striker_id",
    T1."non_striker_id",
    T1."total_runs",
    COALESCE(SUM(T1."is_wicket") OVER (PARTITION BY T1."match_id" ORDER BY T1."over_number", T1."ball_number" ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING), 0) AS "wickets_down"
  FROM WicketEvents AS T1
  JOIN "Matches" AS M
    ON T1."match_id" = M."match_id"
  WHERE
    M."result_type" != 'no result'
), PartnershipStats AS (
  SELECT
    SUM("total_runs") AS "partnership_runs",
    MIN(CASE WHEN "striker_id" < "non_striker_id" THEN "striker_id" ELSE "non_striker_id" END) AS "batsman1_id",
    MAX(CASE WHEN "striker_id" > "non_striker_id" THEN "striker_id" ELSE "non_striker_id" END) AS "batsman2_id"
  FROM PartnershipGroups
  WHERE
    "wickets_down" >= 4
  GROUP BY
    "match_id",
    "wickets_down"
)
SELECT
  PS."partnership_runs",
  P1."player_name",
  P2."player_name"
FROM PartnershipStats AS PS
JOIN "Players" AS P1
  ON PS."batsman1_id" = P1."player_id"
JOIN "Players" AS P2
  ON PS."batsman2_id" = P2."player_id"
ORDER BY
  PS."partnership_runs" DESC
LIMIT 1;
generated_sql:
WITH PartnershipCTE AS (
    SELECT
        d.match_id,
        d.inning,
        d.over_number,
        d.ball_number,
        d.striker_id,
        d.non_striker_id,
        d.runs_scored,
        d.extra_runs,
        p1.player_name AS striker_name,
        p2.player_name AS non_striker_name,
        CASE
            WHEN d.wicket_type IS NOT NULL AND d.player_out_id IN (d.striker_id, d.non_striker_id) THEN 1
            ELSE 0
        END AS wicket_fell
    FROM Deliveries d
    JOIN Players p1 ON d.striker_id = p1.player_id
    JOIN Players p2 ON d.non_striker_id = p2.player_id
    JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id
    WHERE m.team1 = 'RCB' OR m.team2 = 'RCB'
),
InningsCTE AS (
    SELECT
        match_id,
        inning,
        SUM(runs_scored + extra_runs) AS total_runs,
        MAX(CASE WHEN wicket_fell = 1 THEN ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY match_id, inning ORDER BY over_number, ball_number) ELSE 0 END) AS last_wicket_delivery
    FROM PartnershipCTE
    GROUP BY match_id, inning
),
WicketCountCTE AS (
    SELECT
        p.match_id,
        p.inning,
        p.over_number,
        p.ball_number,
        p.striker_id,
        p.non_striker_id,
        p.runs_scored,
        p.extra_runs,
        p.striker_name,
        p.non_striker_name,
        SUM(p.wicket_fell) OVER (PARTITION BY p.match_id, p.inning ORDER BY p.over_number, p.ball_number) AS wickets_so_far
    FROM PartnershipCTE p
),
FilteredPartnerships AS (
    SELECT
        w.match_id,
        w.inning,
        w.over_number,
        w.ball_number,
        w.striker_id,
        w.non_striker_id,
        w.runs_scored,
        w.extra_runs,
        w.striker_name,
        w.non_striker_name,
        w.wickets_so_far,
        SUM(w.runs_scored) OVER (PARTITION BY w.match_id, w.inning, w.wickets_so_far ORDER BY w.over_number, w.ball_number) AS partnership_runs
    FROM WicketCountCTE w
    JOIN Matches m ON w.match_id = m.match_id
    WHERE (m.team1 = 'RCB' OR m.team2 = 'RCB')
      AND w.batting_team = 'RCB'
      AND w.wickets_so_far >= 4
      AND w.inning = 2
),
MaxPartnership AS (
    SELECT
        match_id,
        inning,
        MAX(partnership_runs) AS max_partnership_runs
    FROM FilteredPartnerships
    GROUP BY match_id, inning
)
SELECT
    fp.striker_name,
    fp.non_striker_name,
    fp.partnership_runs
FROM FilteredPartnerships fp
JOIN MaxPartnership mp ON fp.match_id = mp.match_id AND fp.inning = mp.inning AND fp.partnership_runs = mp.max_partnership_runs
ORDER BY fp.partnership_runs DESC
LIMIT 1;

question: List the teams that failed to have a 50 run opening stand in a season.List the teams,year and their highest opening stand for that season
query:
WITH OpeningPartnershipRuns AS (
  SELECT
    T1."match_id",
    T1."inning",
    T1."batting_team",
    SUM(T1."runs_scored" + T1."extra_runs") AS opening_runs
  FROM "Deliveries" AS T1
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
      "match_id",
      "inning",
      MIN("delivery_id") AS first_wicket_delivery_id
    FROM "Deliveries"
    WHERE
      "wicket_type" IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY
      "match_id",
      "inning"
  ) AS T2
    ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id"
    AND T1."inning" = T2."inning"
  WHERE
    T1."delivery_id" < T2.first_wicket_delivery_id OR T2.first_wicket_delivery_id IS NULL
  GROUP BY
    T1."match_id",
    T1."inning",
    T1."batting_team"
)
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN T1."batting_team" = 'Delhi Daredevils'
    THEN 'Delhi Capitals'
    WHEN T1."batting_team" = 'Kings XI Punjab'
    THEN 'Punjab Kings'
    WHEN T1."batting_team" = 'Deccan Chargers'
    THEN 'Sunrisers Hyderabad'
    WHEN T1."batting_team" IN ('Pune Warriors', 'Rising Pune Supergiants')
    THEN 'Rising Pune Supergiant'
    WHEN T1."batting_team" = 'Royal Challengers Bangalore'
    THEN 'Royal Challengers Bengaluru'
    ELSE T1."batting_team"
  END AS "team",
  T2."season" AS "year",
  MAX(T1."opening_runs") AS "highest_opening_stand"
FROM OpeningPartnershipRuns AS T1
JOIN "Matches" AS T2
  ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id"
GROUP BY
  "team",
  "year"
HAVING
  MAX(T1."opening_runs") < 50
ORDER BY
  "team",
  "year";
generated_sql:
SELECT 
    pim.team_name AS team,
    m.season AS year,
    MAX(opening_stand) AS highest_opening_stand
FROM 
    PlayerInMatch pim
JOIN 
    Matches m ON pim.match_id = m.match_id
JOIN (
    SELECT 
        d.match_id,
        d.batting_team,
        d.inning,
        SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) AS opening_stand
    FROM 
        Deliveries d
    WHERE 
        d.over_number = 0 AND d.ball_number = 1
    GROUP BY 
        d.match_id, d.batting_team, d.inning
) AS first_over ON pim.match_id = first_over.match_id AND pim.team_name = first_over.batting_team
GROUP BY 
    pim.team_name, m.season

query:
WITH OpeningPartnershipRuns AS (
  SELECT
    T1."match_id",
    T1."inning",
    T1."batting_team",
    SUM(T1."runs_scored" + T1."extra_runs") AS opening_runs
  FROM "Deliveries" AS T1
  LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
      "match_id",
      "inning",
      MIN("delivery_id") AS first_wicket_delivery_id
    FROM "Deliveries"
    WHERE
      "wicket_type" IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY
      "match_id",
      "inning"
  ) AS T2
    ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id"
    AND T1."inning" = T2."inning"
  WHERE
    T1."delivery_id" < T2.first_wicket_delivery_id OR T2.first_wicket_delivery_id IS NULL
  GROUP BY
    T1."match_id",
    T1."inning",
    T1."batting_team"
)
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN T1."batting_team" = 'Delhi Daredevils'
    THEN 'Delhi Capitals'
    WHEN T1."batting_team" = 'Kings XI Punjab'
    THEN 'Punjab Kings'
    WHEN T1."batting_team" = 'Deccan Chargers'
    THEN 'Sunrisers Hyderabad'
    WHEN T1."batting_team" IN ('Pune Warriors', 'Rising Pune Supergiants')
    THEN 'Rising Pune Supergiant'
    WHEN T1."batting_team" = 'Royal Challengers Bangalore'
    THEN 'Royal Challengers Bengaluru'
    ELSE T1."batting_team"
  END AS "team",
  T2."season" AS "year",
  MAX(T1."opening_runs") AS "highest_opening_stand"
FROM OpeningPartnershipRuns AS T1
JOIN "Matches" AS T2
  ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id"

  "team",

    FROM "Deliveries"
    WHERE
      "wicket_type" IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY
      "match_id",
      "inning"
  ) AS T2
    ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id"
    AND T1."inning" = T2."inning"
  WHERE
    T1."delivery_id" < T2.first_wicket_delivery_id OR T2.first_wicket_delivery_id IS NULL
  GROUP BY
    T1."match_id",
    T1."inning",
    T1."batting_team"
)
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN T1."batting_team" = 'Delhi Daredevils'
    THEN 'Delhi Capitals'
    WHEN T1."batting_team" = 'Kings XI Punjab'
    THEN 'Punjab Kings'
    WHEN T1."batting_team" = 'Deccan Chargers'
    THEN 'Sunrisers Hyderabad'
    WHEN T1."batting_team" IN ('Pune Warriors', 'Rising Pune Supergiants')
    THEN 'Rising Pune Supergiant'
    WHEN T1."batting_team" = 'Royal Challengers Bangalore'
    THEN 'Royal Challengers Bengaluru'
    ELSE T1."batting_team"
  END AS "team",
  T2."season" AS "year",
  MAX(T1."opening_runs") AS "highest_opening_stand"
FROM OpeningPartnershipRuns AS T1
JOIN "Matches" AS T2
  ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id"
GROUP BY
  "team",
  "year"
HAVING
  MAX(T1."opening_runs") < 50
ORDER BY
  "team",
  "year";

    pim.team_name AS team,
    m.season AS year,
    MAX(opening_stand.opening_partnership) AS max_opening_stand
FROM 
    PlayerInMatch pim
JOIN 
    Matches m ON pim.match_id = m.match_id
JOIN (
    SELECT 
        d.match_id,
        d.inning,
        d.batting_team,
        SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) AS opening_partnership
    FROM 
        Deliveries d
    WHERE 
        d.over_number = 1 AND d.ball_number = 1
    GROUP BY 
        d.match_id, d.inning, d.batting_team
) AS opening_stand 
ON 
    pim.match_id = opening_stand.match_id 
    AND pim.team_name = opening_stand.batting_team
GROUP BY 
    pim.team_name, m.season
HAVING 
    MAX(opening_stand.opening_partnership) < 50;

question: IPL à¤®à¥‡à¤‚ à¤¸à¤¬à¤¸à¥‡ à¤œà¤¼à¥à¤¯à¤¾à¤¦à¤¾ à¤¸à¤¾à¤à¥‡à¤¦à¤¾à¤°à¥€ à¤”à¤¸à¤¤ à¤µà¤¾à¤²à¥€ à¤¶à¥€à¤°à¥à¤· 4 à¤œà¥‹à¤¡à¤¼à¤¿à¤¯à¤¾à¤ (à¤¨à¥à¤¯à¥‚à¤¨à¤¤à¤® 1000 à¤°à¤¨)à¥¤
query:
WITH PartnershipDeliveries AS (
  SELECT
    MIN("striker_id", "non_striker_id") AS p1_id,
    MAX("striker_id", "non_striker_id") AS p2_id,
    "runs_scored",
    "extra_runs",
    "player_out_id",
    "wicket_type"
  FROM "Deliveries"
), PartnershipStats AS (
  SELECT
    p1_id,
    p2_id,
    SUM("runs_scored" + "extra_runs") AS total_runs,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN "player_out_id" IN (p1_id, p2_id) AND "wicket_type" NOT IN ('retired hurt', 'obstructing the field', 'retired out') THEN 1 END) AS dismissals
  FROM PartnershipDeliveries
  GROUP BY
    p1_id,
    p2_id
)
SELECT
  p1."player_name",
  p2."player_name",
  CAST(ps.total_runs AS REAL) / ps.dismissals AS "Partnership Average"
FROM PartnershipStats AS ps
JOIN "Players" AS p1
  ON ps.p1_id = p1."player_id"
JOIN "Players" AS p2
  ON ps.p2_id = p2."player_id"
WHERE
  ps.total_runs >= 1000 AND ps.dismissals > 0
ORDER BY
  "Partnership Average" DESC
LIMIT 4;

SELECT 
    p1.player_name AS player1,
    p2.player_name AS player2,
    SUM(d.runs_scored) AS total_runs,
    COUNT(*) AS partnership_balls,
    ROUND(CAST(SUM(d.runs_scored) AS FLOAT) * 100 / COUNT(*), 2) AS partnership_average
FROM 
    Deliveries d
JOIN 
    Deliveries d2 ON d.match_id = d2.match_id 
    AND d.inning = d2.inning 
    AND d.over_number = d2.over_number 
    AND d.ball_number = d2.ball_number
    AND d.striker_id = d2.striker_id
JOIN 
    Players p1 ON d.striker_id = p1.player_id
JOIN 
    Players p2 ON d.non_striker_id = p2.player_id
WHERE 
    d.striker_id < d.non_striker_id
GROUP BY 
    d.striker_id, d.non_striker_id
HAVING 
    SUM(d.runs_scored) >= 1000
ORDER BY 
    partnership_average DESC
LIMIT 4;

question: top 4 Highest partnership average in ipl with minimum 1000 runs.
query:
WITH PartnershipDeliveries AS (
  SELECT
    MIN("striker_id", "non_striker_id") AS p1_id,
    MAX("striker_id", "non_striker_id") AS p2_id,
    "runs_scored",
    "extra_runs",
    "player_out_id",
    "wicket_type"
  FROM "Deliveries"
), PartnershipStats AS (
  SELECT
    p1_id,
    p2_id,
    SUM("runs_scored" + "extra_runs") AS total_runs,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN "player_out_id" IN (p1_id, p2_id) AND "wicket_type" NOT IN ('retired hurt', 'obstructing the field', 'retired out') THEN 1 END) AS dismissals
  FROM PartnershipDeliveries
  GROUP BY
    p1_id,
    p2_id
)
SELECT
  p1."player_name",
  p2."player_name",
  CAST(ps.total_runs AS REAL) / ps.dismissals AS "Partnership Average"
FROM PartnershipStats AS ps
JOIN "Players" AS p1
  ON ps.p1_id = p1."player_id"
JOIN "Players" AS p2
  ON ps.p2_id = p2."player_id"
WHERE
  ps.total_runs >= 1000 AND ps.dismissals > 0
ORDER BY
  "Partnership Average" DESC
LIMIT 4;
generated_sql:
SELECT 
    p1.player_name AS player1_name,
    p2.player_name AS player2_name,
    SUM(d.runs_scored) AS total_runs,
    CAST(SUM(d.runs_scored) AS FLOAT) / COUNT(DISTINCT d.match_id) AS partnership_average
FROM 
    Deliveries d
    JOIN PlayerInMatch pm1 ON d.match_id = pm1.match_id AND d.striker_id = pm1.player_id
    JOIN PlayerInMatch pm2 ON d.match_id = pm2.match_id AND d.non_striker_id = pm2.player_id
    JOIN Players p1 ON d.striker_id = p1.player_id
    JOIN Players p2 ON d.non_striker_id = p2.player_id
WHERE 
    d.batting_team = pm1.team_name AND d.batting_team = pm2.team_name
GROUP BY 
    d.striker_id, d.non_striker_id
HAVING 
    SUM(d.runs_scored) >= 1000
ORDER BY 
    partnership_average DESC
LIMIT 4;

question: à¤à¤• à¤¸à¥€à¤œà¤¼à¤¨ à¤®à¥‡à¤‚ 25 à¤¯à¤¾ à¤‰à¤¸à¤¸à¥‡ à¤•à¤® à¤—à¥‡à¤‚à¤¦à¥‹à¤‚ à¤®à¥‡à¤‚ à¤¸à¤¬à¤¸à¥‡ à¤œà¤¼à¥à¤¯à¤¾à¤¦à¤¾ à¤¬à¤¾à¤° à¤ªà¤šà¤¾à¤¸à¤¾ (50 à¤°à¤¨) à¤²à¤—à¤¾à¤¨à¥‡ à¤µà¤¾à¤²à¥‡ 3 à¤¬à¤²à¥à¤²à¥‡à¤¬à¤¾à¤œà¤¼à¥¤
query:
WITH BatsmanInnings AS (
  SELECT
    T1."match_id",
    T1."striker_id",
    T2."season",
    SUM(T1."runs_scored") OVER (
      PARTITION BY
        T1."match_id",
        T1."striker_id"
      ORDER BY
        T1."inning",
        T1."over_number",
        T1."ball_number"
    ) AS "cumulative_runs",
    SUM(
      CASE WHEN NOT (
        T1."extra_runs" > 0
        AND T1."runs_scored" = 0
        AND T1."wicket_type" IS NULL
      ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
    ) OVER (
      PARTITION BY
        T1."match_id",
        T1."striker_id"
      ORDER BY
        T1."inning",
        T1."over_number",
        T1."ball_number"
    ) AS "cumulative_balls_faced"
  FROM "Deliveries" AS T1
  INNER JOIN "Matches" AS T2
    ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id"
), BallsToFifty AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "striker_id",
    "season",
    MIN("cumulative_balls_faced") AS "balls_taken"
  FROM BatsmanInnings
  WHERE
    "cumulative_runs" >= 50
  GROUP BY
    "match_id",
    "striker_id",
    "season"
), FastFifties AS (
  SELECT
    "striker_id",
    "season"
  FROM BallsToFifty
  WHERE
    "balls_taken" <= 25
), SeasonCounts AS (
  SELECT
    "striker_id",
    "season",
    COUNT(*) AS "num_fast_fifties"
  FROM FastFifties
  GROUP BY
    "striker_id",
    "season"
)
SELECT
  T2."player_name",
  T1."season",
  T1."num_fast_fifties"
FROM SeasonCounts AS T1
INNER JOIN "Players" AS T2
  ON T1."striker_id" = T2."player_id"
ORDER BY
  T1."num_fast_fifties" DESC
LIMIT 3;

SELECT 
    p.player_name,
    COUNT(*) AS fifty_count
FROM Deliveries d
JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id
JOIN Players p ON d.striker_id = p.player_id
WHERE d.inning IN (1, 2)
GROUP BY p.player_id, m.season
HAVING SUM(d.runs_scored) >= 50
   AND SUM(CASE WHEN d.wides = 0 AND d.noballs = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) <= 25
ORDER BY fifty_count DESC
LIMIT 3;

WITH BatsmanInnings AS (
  SELECT
    T1."match_id",
    T1."striker_id",
    T2."season",
    SUM(T1."runs_scored") OVER (
      PARTITION BY
        T1."match_id",
        T1."striker_id"
      ORDER BY
        T1."inning",
        T1."over_number",
        T1."ball_number"
    ) AS "cumulative_runs",
    SUM(
      CASE WHEN NOT (
        T1."extra_runs" > 0
        AND T1."runs_scored" = 0
        AND T1."wicket_type" IS NULL
      ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
    ) OVER (
      PARTITION BY
        T1."match_id",
        T1."striker_id"
      ORDER BY
        T1."inning",
        T1."over_number",
        T1."ball_number"
    ) AS "cumulative_balls_faced"
  FROM "Deliveries" AS T1
  INNER JOIN "Matches" AS T2
    ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id"

  SELECT

WITH PartnershipData AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "inning",
    "striker_id",
    "non_striker_id",
    "runs_scored" + "extra_runs" AS total_runs,
    SUM(CASE WHEN "player_out_id" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY "match_id", "inning" ORDER BY "over_number", "ball_number" ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS wicket_group
  FROM "Deliveries"
  WHERE
    "batting_team" = 'Lucknow Super Giants'
), PartnershipPairs AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "inning",
    wicket_group,
    MIN("striker_id") AS p1_id,
    MAX("striker_id") AS p2_id,
    SUM(total_runs) AS partnership_runs
  FROM PartnershipData
  GROUP BY
    "match_id",
    "inning",
    wicket_group
)
SELECT
  T2."player_name",
  T3."player_name",
  T1.partnership_runs
FROM PartnershipPairs AS T1
JOIN "Players" AS T2
  ON T1.p1_id = T2."player_id"
JOIN "Players" AS T3
  ON T1.p2_id = T3."player_id"
WHERE
  T1.wicket_group >= 1
ORDER BY

WITH BatsmanInnings AS (
  SELECT
    T1."match_id",

    ) AS "cumulative_runs",

WITH FranchiseMatches AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    CASE
      WHEN "team_name" IN ('Delhi Daredevils', 'Delhi Capitals') THEN 'Delhi Capitals'
      WHEN "team_name" IN ('Kings XI Punjab', 'Punjab Kings') THEN 'Punjab Kings'
      WHEN "team_name" IN ('Deccan Chargers', 'Sunrisers Hyderabad') THEN 'Sunrisers Hyderabad'
      WHEN "team_name" IN ('Pune Warriors', 'Rising Pune Supergiant', 'Rising Pune Supergiants') THEN 'Rising Pune Supergiant'
      WHEN "team_name" IN ('Royal Challengers Bangalore', 'Royal Challengers Bengaluru') THEN 'Royal Challengers Bengaluru'
      ELSE "team_name"
    END AS "franchise_name"
  FROM
    (
      SELECT
        "match_id",
        "team1" AS "team_name"
      FROM "Matches"
      UNION ALL
      SELECT
        "match_id",
        "team2" AS "team_name"
      FROM "Matches"
    )
), FranchiseMatchNumbers AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "franchise_name",
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "franchise_name" ORDER BY "match_id") AS "franchise_match_seq"
  FROM FranchiseMatches
), PlayerAppearanceSequence AS (
  SELECT
    T1."player_id",
    T2."franchise_name",
    T2."franchise_match_seq"
  FROM "PlayerInMatch" AS T1
  JOIN FranchiseMatchNumbers AS T2
    ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id"
  WHERE
    T2."franchise_name" = CASE
      WHEN T1."team_name" IN ('Delhi Daredevils', 'Delhi Capitals') THEN 'Delhi Capitals'
      WHEN T1."team_name" IN ('Kings XI Punjab', 'Punjab Kings') THEN 'Punjab Kings'
      WHEN T1."team_name" IN ('Deccan Chargers', 'Sunrisers Hyderabad') THEN 'Sunrisers Hyderabad'
      WHEN T1."team_name" IN ('Pune Warriors', 'Rising Pune Supergiant', 'Rising Pune Supergiants') THEN 'Rising Pune Supergiant'
      WHEN T1."team_name" IN ('Royal Challengers Bangalore', 'Royal Challengers Bengaluru') THEN 'Royal Challengers Bengaluru'
      ELSE T1."team_name"
    END
), AppearanceGaps AS (
  SELECT
    "player_id",
    "franchise_name",
    "franchise_match_seq" - LAG("franchise_match_seq", 1) OVER (PARTITION BY "player_id", "franchise_name" ORDER BY "franchise_match_seq") AS "gap"
  FROM PlayerAppearanceSequence
)
SELECT
  T3."player_name",
  T4."franchise_name",
  T4."gap" - 1 AS "matches_missed"
FROM AppearanceGaps AS T4
JOIN "Players" AS T3
  ON T4."player_id" = T3."player_id"
WHERE
  T4."gap" > 1
ORDER BY
  "matches_missed" DESC
LIMIT 5;

    FROM PlayerFranchiseMatches

),

    SELECT 
        pfm.player_name,
        pfm.franchise,
        pfm.first_match,
        pfm.last_match,
        pfm.matches_played,
        LAG(pfm.first_match) OVER (PARTITION BY pfm.player_name ORDER BY pfm.first_match) AS prev_last_match,
        LAG(pfm.franchise) OVER (PARTITION BY pfm.player_name ORDER BY pfm.first_match) AS prev_franchise

        pfg.prev_franchise,

        COUNT(m.match_id) AS matches_between

    GROUP BY pfg.player_name, pfg.franchise, pfg.prev_franchise, pfg.first_match, pfg.prev_last_match
),
RankedPlayers AS (
    SELECT

        SUM(matches_between) AS total_matches_between,

    FROM PlayerFranchiseSwitches

question: player Reaching 50 in fewer than 20 balls most times in IPL.list the top 4
query:
WITH CumulativeStats AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "inning",
    "striker_id",
    SUM("runs_scored") OVER (PARTITION BY "match_id", "inning", "striker_id" ORDER BY "over_number", "ball_number") AS "cumulative_runs",
    COUNT(CASE WHEN NOT ("extra_runs" > 0 AND "runs_scored" = 0 AND "wicket_type" IS NULL) THEN 1 END) OVER (PARTITION BY "match_id", "inning", "striker_id" ORDER BY "over_number", "ball_number") AS "balls_faced"
  FROM "Deliveries"
), InningsFifty AS (
  SELECT
    "striker_id",
    "match_id",
    "inning",
    MIN("balls_faced") AS "balls_to_reach_50"
  FROM CumulativeStats
  WHERE
    "cumulative_runs" >= 50
  GROUP BY
    "striker_id",
    "match_id",
    "inning"
)
SELECT
  T2."player_name",
  COUNT(T1."striker_id") AS "fast_fifties_count"
FROM InningsFifty AS T1
JOIN "Players" AS T2
  ON T1."striker_id" = T2."player_id"
WHERE
  T1."balls_to_reach_50" < 20
GROUP BY
  T2."player_name"
ORDER BY
  "fast_fifties_count" DESC
LIMIT 4;
generated_sql:
SELECT p.player_name, COUNT(*) AS fifty_count
FROM Players p
JOIN Deliveries d ON p.player_id = d.striker_id
JOIN (
    SELECT match_id, striker_id, SUM(runs_scored) AS total_runs, COUNT(*) AS balls_faced
    FROM Deliveries
    GROUP BY match_id, striker_id
    HAVING total_runs >= 50 AND balls_faced < 20
) fifty ON p.player_id = fifty.striker_id AND d.match_id = fifty.match_id
GROUP BY p.player_id, p.player_name
ORDER BY fifty_count DESC
LIMIT 4;

question: list all instances of 100+ opening stands for lsg.the total runs and the batters involved
query:
WITH FirstWicket AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "inning",
    MIN("delivery_id") AS first_wicket_delivery_id
  FROM "Deliveries"
  WHERE
    "wicket_type" IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY
    "match_id",
    "inning"
), OpeningPartnershipRuns AS (
  SELECT
    T1."match_id",
    T1."inning",
    T1."batting_team",
    SUM(T1."runs_scored" + T1."extra_runs") AS partnership_runs
  FROM "Deliveries" AS T1
  LEFT JOIN FirstWicket AS T2
    ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id"
    AND T1."inning" = T2."inning"
  WHERE
    T2.first_wicket_delivery_id IS NULL
    OR T1."delivery_id" < T2.first_wicket_delivery_id
  GROUP BY
    T1."match_id",
    T1."inning",
    T1."batting_team"
), OpeningBatsmen AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "inning",
    "striker_id",
    "non_striker_id"
  FROM "Deliveries"
  WHERE
    "delivery_id" IN (
      SELECT
        MIN("delivery_id")
      FROM "Deliveries"
      GROUP BY
        "match_id",
        "inning"
    )
)
SELECT
  T1.partnership_runs,
  T3."player_name",
  T4."player_name"
FROM OpeningPartnershipRuns AS T1
INNER JOIN OpeningBatsmen AS T2
  ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id"
  AND T1."inning" = T2."inning"
INNER JOIN "Players" AS T3
  ON T2."striker_id" = T3."player_id"
INNER JOIN "Players" AS T4
  ON T2."non_striker_id" = T4."player_id"
WHERE
  T1.batting_team = 'Lucknow Super Giants' AND T1.partnership_runs >= 100
ORDER BY
  T1.partnership_runs DESC;

FROM

question: highest partnership to get a 10-wicket win in ipl
query:
WITH TenWicketWinMatches AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "match_winner"
  FROM "Matches"
  WHERE
    "result_type" = 'wickets' AND "result_margin" = 10
), PartnershipRuns AS (
  SELECT
    T1."match_id",
    SUM(T2."runs_scored" + T2."extra_runs") AS total_runs
  FROM TenWicketWinMatches AS T1
  JOIN "Deliveries" AS T2
    ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id"
  WHERE
    T2."batting_team" = T1."match_winner"
  GROUP BY
    T1."match_id"
), Partners AS (
  SELECT
    T1."match_id",
    T2."striker_id" AS player_id
  FROM TenWicketWinMatches AS T1
  JOIN "Deliveries" AS T2
    ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id"
  WHERE
    T2."batting_team" = T1."match_winner"
  UNION
  SELECT
    T1."match_id",
    T2."non_striker_id" AS player_id
  FROM TenWicketWinMatches AS T1
  JOIN "Deliveries" AS T2
    ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id"
  WHERE
    T2."batting_team" = T1."match_winner"
)
SELECT
  T2."total_runs",
  GROUP_CONCAT(T4."player_name", ' and ') AS partnership_players
FROM Partners AS T1
JOIN PartnershipRuns AS T2
  ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id"
JOIN "Players" AS T4
  ON T1."player_id" = T4."player_id"
GROUP BY
  T1."match_id"
ORDER BY
  T2."total_runs" DESC
LIMIT 1;
generated_sql:
SELECT MAX(runs_scored) AS highest_partnership
FROM (
    SELECT d1.striker_id, d1.non_striker_id, SUM(d1.runs_scored) AS runs_scored
    FROM Deliveries d1
    INNER JOIN Matches m ON d1.match_id = m.match_id
    WHERE m.result_type = 'wickets' AND m.result_margin = 10
    GROUP BY d1.match_id, d1.inning, d1.striker_id, d1.non_striker_id

WITH TenWicketWinMatches AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "match_winner"
  FROM "Matches"
  WHERE
    "result_type" = 'wickets' AND "result_margin" = 10
), PartnershipRuns AS (
  SELECT
    T1."match_id",
    SUM(T2."runs_scored" + T2."extra_runs") AS total_runs
  FROM TenWicketWinMatches AS T1
  JOIN "Deliveries" AS T2
    ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id"
  WHERE
    T2."batting_team" = T1."match_winner"
  GROUP BY
    T1."match_id"
), Partners AS (
  SELECT
    T1."match_id",
    T2."striker_id" AS player_id
  FROM TenWicketWinMatches AS T1
  JOIN "Deliveries" AS T2
    ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id"
  WHERE
    T2."batting_team" = T1."match_winner"
  UNION
  SELECT
    T1."match_id",
    T2."non_striker_id" AS player_id
  FROM TenWicketWinMatches AS T1
  JOIN "Deliveries" AS T2
    ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id"
  WHERE
    T2."batting_team" = T1."match_winner"
)
SELECT
  T2."total_runs",
  GROUP_CONCAT(T4."player_name", ' and ') AS partnership_players
FROM Partners AS T1
JOIN PartnershipRuns AS T2
  ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id"
JOIN "Players" AS T4
  ON T1."player_id" = T4."player_id"
GROUP BY
  T1."match_id"
ORDER BY
  T2."total_runs" DESC
LIMIT 1;

WITH PlayerInnings AS (
  SELECT
    "runs_scored",
    SUM(CASE WHEN "wides" = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (
      ORDER BY
        "over_number",
        "ball_number"
    ) AS "cumulative_balls_faced",
    SUM("runs_scored") OVER (
      ORDER BY
        "over_number",
        "ball_number"
    ) AS "cumulative_runs_scored"
  FROM "Deliveries"
  WHERE
    "striker_id" = (
      SELECT
        "player_id"
      FROM "Players"
      WHERE
        "player_name" LIKE 'KL Rahul%'
    ) AND "match_id" = (
      SELECT
        T1."match_id"
      FROM "Deliveries" AS T1
      INNER JOIN "Players" AS T2
        ON T1."striker_id" = T2."player_id"
      INNER JOIN "Matches" AS T3
        ON T1."match_id" = T3."match_id"
      WHERE
        T2."player_name" LIKE 'KL Rahul%' AND T3."season" = '2025' AND (
          (
            (
              CASE
                WHEN T3."team1" IN ('Delhi Daredevils', 'Delhi Capitals')
                THEN 'Delhi Capitals'
                ELSE T3."team1"
              END
            ) = 'Delhi Capitals' AND T3."team2" = 'Gujarat Titans'
          ) OR (
            T3."team1" = 'Gujarat Titans' AND (
              CASE
                WHEN T3."team2" IN ('Delhi Daredevils', 'Delhi Capitals')
                THEN 'Delhi Capitals'
                ELSE T3."team2"
              END
            ) = 'Delhi Capitals'
          )
        )
      GROUP BY
        T1."match_id"
      HAVING
        SUM(T1."runs_scored") >= 100
      LIMIT 1
    )
)
SELECT
  MAX("cumulative_balls_faced") AS "balls_faced",
  MAX("cumulative_runs_scored") AS "runs_scored"
FROM PlayerInnings
WHERE
  "cumulative_balls_faced" > 0
GROUP BY
  ("cumulative_balls_faced" - 1) / 20
ORDER BY
  "balls_faced";

WITH FirstWicket AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "inning",
    MIN("delivery_id") AS first_wicket_delivery
  FROM "Deliveries"
  WHERE
    "player_out_id" IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY
    "match_id",
    "inning"
), OpeningPartnershipRuns AS (
  SELECT
    T1."match_id",
    T1."inning",
    SUM(T1."runs_scored" + T1."extra_runs") AS partnership_runs
  FROM "Deliveries" AS T1
  LEFT JOIN FirstWicket AS T2
    ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id"
    AND T1."inning" = T2."inning"
  WHERE
    T1."delivery_id" < T2.first_wicket_delivery OR T2.first_wicket_delivery IS NULL
  GROUP BY
    T1."match_id",
    T1."inning"
), OpeningPairs AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "inning",
    CASE WHEN "striker_id" < "non_striker_id" THEN "striker_id" ELSE "non_striker_id" END AS player1_id,
    CASE WHEN "striker_id" < "non_striker_id" THEN "non_striker_id" ELSE "striker_id" END AS player2_id
  FROM "Deliveries"
  WHERE
    "over_number" = 0 AND "ball_number" = 1
)
SELECT
  T5."player_name",
  T6."player_name",
  T4."season",
  COUNT(T3."match_id") AS num_50_plus_stands
FROM OpeningPartnershipRuns AS T3
INNER JOIN "Matches" AS T4
  ON T3."match_id" = T4."match_id"
INNER JOIN OpeningPairs AS T7
  ON T3."match_id" = T7."match_id"
  AND T3."inning" = T7."inning"
INNER JOIN "Players" AS T5
  ON T7.player1_id = T5."player_id"
INNER JOIN "Players" AS T6
  ON T7.player2_id = T6."player_id"
WHERE
  T3.partnership_runs > 50
GROUP BY
  T4."season",
  T5."player_name",
  T6."player_name"
ORDER BY
  num_50_plus_stands DESC
LIMIT 1;

WITH DefeatCounts AS (
  SELECT
    "season",
    CASE
      WHEN "toss_decision" = 'field' THEN "toss_winner"
      WHEN "toss_winner" = "team1" THEN "team2"
      ELSE "team1"
    END AS chasing_team,
    "match_winner"
  FROM "Matches"
  WHERE
    "match_winner" IS NOT NULL
), SeasonDefeats AS (
  SELECT
    "season",
    chasing_team,
    COUNT(*) AS num_defeats
  FROM DefeatCounts
  WHERE
    chasing_team <> "match_winner"
  GROUP BY
    "season",
    chasing_team
)
SELECT
  chasing_team,
  "season",
  num_defeats
FROM SeasonDefeats
WHERE
  num_defeats = (
    SELECT
      MAX(num_defeats)
    FROM SeasonDefeats
  )
ORDER BY
  "season";

WITH PartnershipRuns AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    CASE WHEN "striker_id" < "non_striker_id" THEN "striker_id" ELSE "non_striker_id" END AS player1_id,
    CASE WHEN "striker_id" < "non_striker_id" THEN "non_striker_id" ELSE "striker_id" END AS player2_id,
    SUM("runs_scored" + "extra_runs") AS partnership_runs
  FROM "Deliveries"
  GROUP BY
    "match_id",
    player1_id,
    player2_id
  HAVING
    partnership_runs >= 100
)
SELECT
  p1."player_name",
  p2."player_name",
  COUNT(*) AS "num_100_plus_partnerships"
FROM PartnershipRuns AS pr
JOIN "Players" AS p1
  ON pr.player1_id = p1."player_id"
JOIN "Players" AS p2
  ON pr.player2_id = p2."player_id"
GROUP BY
  p1."player_name",
  p2."player_name"
ORDER BY
  "num_100_plus_partnerships" DESC
LIMIT 5;
generated_sql:
SELECT 
    p1.player_name AS player1_name,
    p2.player_name AS player2_name,
    COUNT(*) AS century_partnerships
FROM Deliveries d1
JOIN Deliveries d2 
    ON d1.match_id = d2.match_id 
    AND d1.inning = d2.inning 
    AND d1.striker_id = d2.non_striker_id 
    AND d2.striker_id = d1.non_striker_id
JOIN PlayerInMatch pm1 ON d1.match_id = pm1.match_id AND d1.striker_id = pm1.player_id
JOIN PlayerInMatch pm2 ON d2.match_id = pm2.match_id AND d2.striker_id = pm2.player_id
JOIN Players p1 ON d1.striker_id = p1.player_id
JOIN Players p2 ON d2.striker_id = p2.player_id
WHERE pm1.team_name = pm2.team_name
GROUP BY 
    CASE WHEN d1.striker_id < d2.striker_id THEN d1.striker_id ELSE d2.striker_id END,
    CASE WHEN d1.striker_id < d2.striker_id THEN d2.striker_id ELSE d1.striker_id END
HAVING SUM(d1.runs_scored + d1.extra_runs + d2.runs_scored + d2.extra_runs) >= 100
ORDER BY century_partnerships DESC
LIMIT 5;

    CASE 
        WHEN m.toss_winner = m.team1 AND m.toss_decision = 'bat' THEN m.team2
        WHEN m.toss_winner = m.team2 AND m.toss_decision = 'bat' THEN m.team1
        ELSE NULL
    END AS chasing_team,
    CASE 
        WHEN m.match_winner IS NOT NULL AND 
             m.match_winner = CASE 
                                WHEN m.toss_winner = m.team1 AND m.toss_decision = 'bat' THEN m.team2
                                WHEN m.toss_winner = m.team2 AND m.toss_decision = 'bat' THEN m.team1
                                ELSE NULL
                              END THEN 'Lost'
        ELSE 'Not Lost'
    END AS chase_result
FROM Matches m
WHERE m.match_winner IS NOT NULL
  AND CASE 
        WHEN m.toss_winner = m.team1 AND m.toss_decision = 'bat' THEN m.team2
        WHEN m.toss_winner = m.team2 AND m.toss_decision = 'bat' THEN m.team1
        ELSE NULL
      END = m.match_winner
ORDER BY m.season;

query:
WITH MatchProgress AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "batting_team",
    SUM("runs_scored" + "extra_runs") OVER (PARTITION BY "match_id", "batting_team" ORDER BY "over_number", "ball_number") AS "cumulative_runs",
    SUM(CASE WHEN "wides" = 0 AND "noballs" = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY "match_id", "batting_team" ORDER BY "over_number", "ball_number") AS "cumulative_legal_balls"
  FROM "Deliveries"
), FiftyMilestones AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "batting_team",
    "cumulative_legal_balls",
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "match_id", "batting_team" ORDER BY "cumulative_legal_balls") AS "rn"
  FROM MatchProgress
  WHERE
    "cumulative_runs" >= 50
)
SELECT
  T2."batting_team",
  T2."cumulative_legal_balls" AS "balls_to_reach_50"
FROM "Matches" AS T1
INNER JOIN FiftyMilestones AS T2
  ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id"
WHERE
  T1."season" = '2025' AND T2."rn" = 1
ORDER BY
  "balls_to_reach_50" ASC
LIMIT 1;

    d.batting_team,

question: list bowling stats of Fazalhaq Farooqi in IPL 2025
query:
SELECT
  SUM(T1.runs_scored + T1.wides + T1.noballs) AS "Runs Conceded",
  COUNT(
    CASE
      WHEN T1.wicket_type IS NOT NULL AND T1.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field', 'retired out')
      THEN 1
    END
  ) AS "Wickets",
  CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN T1.wides = 0 AND T1.noballs = 0 THEN 1 END) / 6 AS TEXT) || '.' || CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN T1.wides = 0 AND T1.noballs = 0 THEN 1 END) % 6 AS TEXT) AS "Overs Bowled",
  (SUM(T1.runs_scored + T1.wides + T1.noballs) * 6.0) / COUNT(CASE WHEN T1.wides = 0 AND T1.noballs = 0 THEN 1 END) AS "Economy Rate"
FROM Deliveries AS T1
INNER JOIN Players AS T2
  ON T1.bowler_id = T2.player_id
INNER JOIN Matches AS T3
  ON T1.match_id = T3.match_id
WHERE
  T2.player_name LIKE 'Fazalhaq Farooqi%' AND T3.season = '2025';

  SUM(T1.runs_scored + T1.wides + T1.noballs) AS "Runs Conceded",
  COUNT(
    CASE
      WHEN T1.wicket_type IS NOT NULL AND T1.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field', 'retired out')
      THEN 1
    END
  ) AS "Wickets",
  CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN T1.wides = 0 AND T1.noballs = 0 THEN 1 END) / 6 AS TEXT) || '.' || CAST(COUNT(CASE WHEN T1.wides = 0 AND T1.noballs = 0 THEN 1 END) % 6 AS TEXT) AS "Overs Bowled",
  (SUM(T1.runs_scored + T1.wides + T1.noballs) * 6.0) / COUNT(CASE WHEN T1.wides = 0 AND T1.noballs = 0 THEN 1 END) AS "Economy Rate"
FROM Deliveries AS T1
INNER JOIN Players AS T2
  ON T1.bowler_id = T2.player_id
INNER JOIN Matches AS T3
  ON T1.match_id = T3.match_id
WHERE
  T2.player_name LIKE 'Fazalhaq Farooqi%' AND T3.season = '2025';

SELECT
  T3."venue",
  T1."batting_team",
  SUM(T1."runs_scored") AS "total_runs"
FROM "Deliveries" AS T1
INNER JOIN (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "inning",
    "batting_team",
    "striker_id",
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "match_id", "inning", "batting_team" ORDER BY MIN("delivery_id")) AS "batting_position"
  FROM "Deliveries"
  GROUP BY
    "match_id",
    "inning",
    "batting_team",
    "striker_id"
) AS T2
  ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id"
  AND T1."inning" = T2."inning"
  AND T1."batting_team" = T2."batting_team"
  AND T1."striker_id" = T2."striker_id"
INNER JOIN "Matches" AS T3
  ON T1."match_id" = T3."match_id"
WHERE
  T2."batting_position" BETWEEN 4 AND 7
GROUP BY
  T1."match_id",
  T1."inning",
  T1."batting_team"
ORDER BY
  "total_runs" DESC
LIMIT 1;

question: 5 Highest totals after being 3 down for < 35 in an IPL innings
query:
WITH InningsProgress AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "inning",
    SUM(CASE WHEN "player_out_id" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY "match_id", "inning" ORDER BY "over_number", "ball_number") AS "wickets_down",
    SUM("runs_scored" + "extra_runs") OVER (PARTITION BY "match_id", "inning" ORDER BY "over_number", "ball_number") AS "current_score"
  FROM "Deliveries"
), QualifyingInnings AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    "match_id",
    "inning"
  FROM InningsProgress
  WHERE
    "wickets_down" = 3 AND "current_score" < 35
)
SELECT
  T2."batting_team",
  SUM(T2."runs_scored" + T2."extra_runs") AS "final_total"
FROM QualifyingInnings AS T1
JOIN "Deliveries" AS T2
  ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id" AND T1."inning" = T2."inning"
GROUP BY
  T1."match_id",
  T1."inning",
  T2."batting_team"
ORDER BY
  "final_total" DESC
LIMIT 5;
generated_sql:
WITH EarlyStruggles AS (
    SELECT 
        d.match_id,
        d.inning,
        SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) AS total_runs
    FROM Deliveries d
    WHERE d.wicket_type IS NOT NULL 
      AND d.wicket_type != 'run out'
    GROUP BY d.match_id, d.inning
    HAVING COUNT(*) = 3
       AND SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) < 35
),
FinalInningsScores AS (
    SELECT 
        d.match_id,
        d.inning,
        SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) AS final_total
    FROM Deliveries d
    GROUP BY d.match_id, d.inning
)
SELECT 
    fis.final_total
FROM EarlyStruggles es
JOIN FinalInningsScores fis 
    ON es.match_id = fis.match_id AND es.inning = fis.inning
ORDER BY fis.final_total DESC
LIMIT 5;

WITH WicketFallInfo AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "batting_team",
    SUM("runs_scored" + "extra_runs") OVER (PARTITION BY "match_id" ORDER BY "over_number", "ball_number") AS cumulative_score,
    SUM(CASE WHEN "wicket_type" IS NOT NULL AND "wicket_type" <> 'retired hurt' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY "match_id" ORDER BY "over_number", "ball_number") AS wicket_count
  FROM "Deliveries"
  WHERE
    "inning" = 2
), FifthWicketScores AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "batting_team",
    MIN(cumulative_score) AS score_at_5th_wicket
  FROM WicketFallInfo
  WHERE
    wicket_count = 5
  GROUP BY
    "match_id",
    "batting_team"
), Targets AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    SUM("runs_scored" + "extra_runs") + 1 AS target

question: Highest SR in debut IPL innings (10+ balls)

WITH DebutInnings AS (
  SELECT
    "player_id",
    MIN("match_id") AS debut_match_id
  FROM PlayerInMatch
  GROUP BY
    "player_id"
)
SELECT
  T3."player_name",
  SUM(T2."runs_scored") * 100.0 / COUNT(CASE WHEN T2."wides" = 0 THEN 1 END) AS strike_rate
FROM DebutInnings AS T1
JOIN Deliveries AS T2
  ON T1."player_id" = T2."striker_id" AND T1."debut_match_id" = T2."match_id"
JOIN Players AS T3
  ON T1."player_id" = T3."player_id"
GROUP BY
  T1."player_id"
HAVING
  COUNT(CASE WHEN T2."wides" = 0 THEN 1 END) >= 10
ORDER BY
  strike_rate DESC
LIMIT 1;

question: give the 3 highest targets chased down after losing first 5 wickets for 75 or lower.list the teams, target and the year.
query:
WITH WicketFallInfo AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "batting_team",
    SUM("runs_scored" + "extra_runs") OVER (PARTITION BY "match_id" ORDER BY "over_number", "ball_number") AS cumulative_score,
    SUM(CASE WHEN "wicket_type" IS NOT NULL AND "wicket_type" <> 'retired hurt' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY "match_id" ORDER BY "over_number", "ball_number") AS wicket_count
  FROM "Deliveries"
  WHERE
    "inning" = 2
), FifthWicketScores AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "batting_team",
    MIN(cumulative_score) AS score_at_5th_wicket
  FROM WicketFallInfo
  WHERE
    wicket_count = 5
  GROUP BY
    "match_id",
    "batting_team"
), Targets AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    SUM("runs_scored" + "extra_runs") + 1 AS target
  FROM "Deliveries"
  WHERE
    "inning" = 1
  GROUP BY
    "match_id"
)
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN T3."match_winner" IN ('Delhi Daredevils', 'Delhi Capitals') THEN 'Delhi Capitals'
    WHEN T3."match_winner" IN ('Kings XI Punjab', 'Punjab Kings') THEN 'Punjab Kings'
    WHEN T3."match_winner" IN ('Deccan Chargers', 'Sunrisers Hyderabad') THEN 'Sunrisers Hyderabad'
    WHEN T3."match_winner" IN ('Pune Warriors', 'Rising Pune Supergiant', 'Rising Pune Supergiants') THEN 'Rising Pune Supergiant'
    WHEN T3."match_winner" IN ('Royal Challengers Bangalore', 'Royal Challengers Bengaluru') THEN 'Royal Challengers Bengaluru'
    ELSE T3."match_winner"
  END AS "winning_team",
  T2.target,
  T3."season"
FROM FifthWicketScores AS T1
JOIN Targets AS T2
  ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id"
JOIN Matches AS T3
  ON T1."match_id" = T3."match_id"
WHERE
  T1.score_at_5th_wicket <= 75 AND T1."batting_team" = T3."match_winner"
ORDER BY
  T2.target DESC
LIMIT 3;

    FROM Deliveries d

WHERE second_innings.total_runs > first_innings.target

LIMIT 3;

WITH WicketFallInfo AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "batting_team",
    SUM("runs_scored" + "extra_runs") OVER (PARTITION BY "match_id" ORDER BY "over_number", "ball_number") AS cumulative_score,
    SUM(CASE WHEN "wicket_type" IS NOT NULL AND "wicket_type" <> 'retired hurt' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY "match_id" ORDER BY "over_number", "ball_number") AS wicket_count
  FROM "Deliveries"
  WHERE
    "inning" = 2
), FifthWicketScores AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "batting_team",
    MIN(cumulative_score) AS score_at_5th_wicket
  FROM WicketFallInfo
  WHERE
    wicket_count = 5
  GROUP BY
    "match_id",
    "batting_team"
), Targets AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    SUM("runs_scored" + "extra_runs") + 1 AS target
  FROM "Deliveries"
  WHERE
    "inning" = 1
  GROUP BY
    "match_id"
)
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN T3."match_winner" IN ('Delhi Daredevils', 'Delhi Capitals') THEN 'Delhi Capitals'
    WHEN T3."match_winner" IN ('Kings XI Punjab', 'Punjab Kings') THEN 'Punjab Kings'
    WHEN T3."match_winner" IN ('Deccan Chargers', 'Sunrisers Hyderabad') THEN 'Sunrisers Hyderabad'
    WHEN T3."match_winner" IN ('Pune Warriors', 'Rising Pune Supergiant', 'Rising Pune Supergiants') THEN 'Rising Pune Supergiant'
    WHEN T3."match_winner" IN ('Royal Challengers Bangalore', 'Royal Challengers Bengaluru') THEN 'Royal Challengers Bengaluru'
    ELSE T3."match_winner"
  END AS "winning_team",
  T2.target,
  T3."season"
FROM FifthWicketScores AS T1
JOIN Targets AS T2
  ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id"
JOIN Matches AS T3
  ON T1."match_id" = T3."match_id"
WHERE
  T1.score_at_5th_wicket <= 75 AND T1."batting_team" = T3."match_winner"
ORDER BY
  T2.target DESC
LIMIT 3;

        MAX(d.over_number * 6 + d.ball_number) AS over_ball_at_5th_wicket
    FROM Deliveries d
    WHERE d.wicket_type IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY d.match_id, d.batting_team
    HAVING COUNT(d.wicket_type) = 5 AND runs_by_5th_wicket <= 75

        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t.target_score DESC) AS rn

        SELECT
            ec.match_id,
            ec.batting_team AS lost_first_5_wickets_team,
            MAX(tot.total_score) AS target_score
        FROM EarlyCollapse ec

            SELECT
                match_id,
                batting_team,
                SUM(runs_scored + extra_runs) AS total_score

    WHERE m.match_winner IS NOT NULL

WITH WicketFallInfo AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "batting_team",
    SUM("runs_scored" + "extra_runs") OVER (PARTITION BY "match_id" ORDER BY "over_number", "ball_number") AS cumulative_score,
    SUM(CASE WHEN "wicket_type" IS NOT NULL AND "wicket_type" <> 'retired hurt' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY "match_id" ORDER BY "over_number", "ball_number") AS wicket_count
  FROM "Deliveries"
  WHERE
    "inning" = 2
), FifthWicketScores AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "batting_team",
    MIN(cumulative_score) AS score_at_5th_wicket
  FROM WicketFallInfo
  WHERE
    wicket_count = 5
  GROUP BY
    "match_id",
    "batting_team"
), Targets AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    SUM("runs_scored" + "extra_runs") + 1 AS target
  FROM "Deliveries"
  WHERE
    "inning" = 1
  GROUP BY
    "match_id"
)

    WHEN T3."match_winner" IN ('Kings XI Punjab', 'Punjab Kings') THEN 'Punjab Kings'
    WHEN T3."match_winner" IN ('Deccan Chargers', 'Sunrisers Hyderabad') THEN 'Sunrisers Hyderabad'
    WHEN T3."match_winner" IN ('Pune Warriors', 'Rising Pune Supergiant', 'Rising Pune Supergiants') THEN 'Rising Pune Supergiant'
    WHEN T3."match_winner" IN ('Royal Challengers Bangalore', 'Royal Challengers Bengaluru') THEN 'Royal Challengers Bengaluru'
    ELSE T3."match_winner"
  END AS "winning_team",
  T2.target,
  T3."season"
FROM FifthWicketScores AS T1
JOIN Targets AS T2
  ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id"
JOIN Matches AS T3
  ON T1."match_id" = T3."match_id"
WHERE
  T1.score_at_5th_wicket <= 75 AND T1."batting_team" = T3."match_winner"
ORDER BY
  T2.target DESC
LIMIT 3;

WITH DebutMatches AS (
  SELECT
    "player_id",
    MIN("match_id") AS debut_match_id
  FROM PlayerInMatch
  GROUP BY
    "player_id"
)
SELECT
  T2."player_name",
  SUM(T1."runs_scored") AS "runs",
  COUNT(CASE WHEN T1."wides" = 0 THEN 1 END) AS "balls_faced",
  SUM(T1."runs_scored") * 100.0 / COUNT(CASE WHEN T1."wides" = 0 THEN 1 END) AS "strike_rate",
  T3."team1",
  T3."team2",
  T3."season"
FROM Deliveries AS T1
INNER JOIN DebutMatches AS DM
  ON T1."striker_id" = DM."player_id" AND T1."match_id" = DM.debut_match_id
INNER JOIN Players AS T2
  ON T1."striker_id" = T2."player_id"
INNER JOIN Matches AS T3
  ON T1."match_id" = T3."match_id"
GROUP BY
  T2."player_name",
  T3."team1",
  T3."team2",
  T3."season"
HAVING
  COUNT(CASE WHEN T1."wides" = 0 THEN 1 END) >= 10
ORDER BY
  "strike_rate" DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT
  "match_date",
  (
    CASE
      WHEN "team1" IN ('Kings XI Punjab', 'Punjab Kings') THEN 'Punjab Kings'
      ELSE "team1"
    END
  ) AS team1_name,
  (
    CASE
      WHEN "team2" IN ('Kings XI Punjab', 'Punjab Kings') THEN 'Punjab Kings'
      ELSE "team2"
    END
  ) AS team2_name,
  "result_type",
  "result_margin"
FROM "Matches"
WHERE
  "city" = 'Dharamsala' AND CAST(strftime('%Y', "match_date") AS INTEGER) >= 2012 AND (
    CASE
      WHEN "match_winner" IN ('Kings XI Punjab', 'Punjab Kings') THEN 'Punjab Kings'
      ELSE "match_winner"
    END
  ) = 'Punjab Kings'
ORDER BY
  "match_date";

  AND m.season > '2012'
  AND m.match_winner IS NOT NULL;

  SELECT

), PlayerRuns AS (
  SELECT
    "striker_id",
    "match_id",
    "batting_team",

    "striker_id",
    "match_id",
    "batting_team"
)

question: most 50+ consecutive scores by an opener across all editions.give the player, his streak, the scores in that streak and the teams and the year.list all the instances of highest streak
query:
WITH OpenerInnings AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    "match_id",
    "inning",
    "striker_id" AS "player_id"
  FROM "Deliveries"
  WHERE
    "over_number" = 0
  UNION
  SELECT DISTINCT
    "match_id",
    "inning",
    "non_striker_id" AS "player_id"
  FROM "Deliveries"
  WHERE
    "over_number" = 0
), OpenerScores AS (
  SELECT
    T1."player_id",
    T2."match_id",
    T3."match_date",
    T3."season",
    T2."batting_team",
    SUM(T2."runs_scored") AS "runs"
  FROM OpenerInnings AS T1
  INNER JOIN "Deliveries" AS T2
    ON T1."player_id" = T2."striker_id"
    AND T1."match_id" = T2."match_id"
    AND T1."inning" = T2."inning"
  INNER JOIN "Matches" AS T3
    ON T1."match_id" = T3."match_id"
  GROUP BY
    T1."player_id",
    T2."match_id"
), RankedScores AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "player_id" ORDER BY "match_date") AS inning_rank
  FROM OpenerScores
), StreakIdentifier AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    inning_rank - ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "player_id" ORDER BY "match_date") AS streak_group
  FROM RankedScores
  WHERE
    "runs" >= 50
), StreakDetails AS (
  SELECT
    "player_id",
    COUNT(*) AS "streak_count",
    GROUP_CONCAT("runs", ', ') AS "scores",
    GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT "batting_team") AS "teams",
    GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT SUBSTR("season", 1, 4)) AS "years"
  FROM StreakIdentifier
  GROUP BY
    "player_id",
    "streak_group"
), MaxStreak AS (
  SELECT
    MAX("streak_count") AS max_streak
  FROM StreakDetails
)
SELECT
  T4."player_name",
  T1."streak_count",
  T1."scores",
  T1."teams",
  T1."years"
FROM StreakDetails AS T1
INNER JOIN MaxStreak AS T2
  ON T1."streak_count" = T2.max_streak
INNER JOIN "Players" AS T4
  ON T1."player_id" = T4."player_id"
ORDER BY
  T4."player_name";

WITH OpeningPartnerships AS (
    SELECT 
        d.match_id,
        d.inning,
        d.striker_id,
        p.player_name,
        m.season,
        pit.team_name,
        SUM(d.runs_scored) AS runs_in_inning
    FROM Deliveries d
    JOIN Players p ON d.striker_id = p.player_id
    JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id
    JOIN PlayerInMatch pit ON d.match_id = pit.match_id AND d.striker_id = pit.player_id
    WHERE d.over_number = 1 AND d.ball_number = 1
    GROUP BY d.match_id, d.inning, d.striker_id, p.player_name, m.season, pit.team_name
),
FiftiesStreaks AS (
    SELECT 
        op.player_name,
        op.team_name,
        op.season,
        op.runs_in_inning,
        CASE 
            WHEN op.runs_in_inning >= 50 THEN 1 
            ELSE 0 
        END AS is_50_plus,
        SUM(CASE 
            WHEN op.runs_in_inning < 50 THEN 1 
            ELSE 0 
        END) OVER (PARTITION BY op.player_name ORDER BY op.match_id, op.inning ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS grp
    FROM OpeningPartnerships op
),
Streaks AS (
    SELECT 
        player_name,
        team_name,
        season,
        runs_in_inning,
        COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY player_name, grp) AS streak_length
    FROM FiftiesStreaks
    WHERE is_50_plus = 1
),
MaxStreak AS (
    SELECT MAX(streak_length) AS max_streak FROM Streaks
)
SELECT 
    s.player_name,
    s.streak_length,
    GROUP_CONCAT(s.runs_in_inning, ', ') AS scores_in_streak,
    GROUP_CONCAT(s.team_name, ', ') AS teams,
    GROUP_CONCAT(s.season, ', ') AS years
FROM Streaks s
CROSS JOIN MaxStreak ms
WHERE s.streak_length = ms.max_streak
GROUP BY s.player_name, s.streak_length;

question: the 2 highest partnerships for the sixth wicket or lower for RR in the IPL. list the partnership runs and the batters involved

WITH WicketInfo AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",

      PARTITION BY "match_id", "inning"
      ORDER BY "over_number", "ball_number"
      ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING
    ), 0) AS "partnership_group"

),

  SELECT
    "match_id",

    "match_id",
    "inning",
    "partnership_group"
),

  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "inning",
    "partnership_group",
    "player_id"
  FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT "match_id", "inning", "partnership_group", "striker_id" AS "player_id" FROM WicketInfo

WITH OpenerInnings AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    "match_id",
    "inning",
    "striker_id" AS "player_id"
  FROM "Deliveries"
  WHERE
    "over_number" = 0
  UNION
  SELECT DISTINCT
    "match_id",
    "inning",
    "non_striker_id" AS "player_id"
  FROM "Deliveries"
  WHERE
    "over_number" = 0
), OpenerScores AS (
  SELECT
    T1."player_id",
    T2."match_id",
    T3."match_date",
    T3."season",
    T2."batting_team",
    SUM(T2."runs_scored") AS "runs"
  FROM OpenerInnings AS T1
  INNER JOIN "Deliveries" AS T2
    ON T1."player_id" = T2."striker_id"
    AND T1."match_id" = T2."match_id"
    AND T1."inning" = T2."inning"
  INNER JOIN "Matches" AS T3
    ON T1."match_id" = T3."match_id"
  GROUP BY
    T1."player_id",
    T2."match_id"
), RankedScores AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "player_id" ORDER BY "match_date") AS inning_rank
  FROM OpenerScores
), StreakIdentifier AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    inning_rank - ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "player_id" ORDER BY "match_date") AS streak_group
  FROM RankedScores
  WHERE
    "runs" >= 50
), StreakDetails AS (
  SELECT
    "player_id",
    COUNT(*) AS "streak_count",
    GROUP_CONCAT("runs", ', ') AS "scores",
    GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT "batting_team") AS "teams",
    GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT SUBSTR("season", 1, 4)) AS "years"
  FROM StreakIdentifier
  GROUP BY
    "player_id",
    "streak_group"
), MaxStreak AS (
  SELECT
    MAX("streak_count") AS max_streak
  FROM StreakDetails
)
SELECT
  T4."player_name",
  T1."streak_count",
  T1."scores",
  T1."teams",
  T1."years"
FROM StreakDetails AS T1
INNER JOIN MaxStreak AS T2
  ON T1."streak_count" = T2.max_streak
INNER JOIN "Players" AS T4
  ON T1."player_id" = T4."player_id"
ORDER BY
  T4."player_name";

  FROM "Deliveries"

    "match_id" IN (

  SELECT
    "partnership_group",

    CASE WHEN "striker_id" < "non_striker_id" THEN "striker_id" ELSE "non_striker_id" END AS "p1_id",
    CASE WHEN "striker_id" < "non_striker_id" THEN "non_striker_id" ELSE "striker_id" END AS "p2_id",

question: IPL à¨µà¨¿à©±à¨š RR à¨²à¨ˆ à¨›à©‡à¨µà©€à¨‚ à¨µà¨¿à¨•à¨Ÿ à¨œà¨¾à¨‚ à¨‰à¨¸ à¨¤à©‹à¨‚ à¨¹à©‡à¨ à¨¾à¨‚ à¨¦à©€à¨†à¨‚ 2 à¨¸à¨­ à¨¤à©‹à¨‚ à¨µà©±à¨¡à©€à¨†à¨‚ à¨¸à¨¾à¨‚à¨à©‡à¨¦à¨¾à¨°à©€à¨†à¨‚à¥¤ à¨¸à¨¾à¨‚à¨à©‡à¨¦à¨¾à¨°à©€ à¨¦à©‡ à¨°à¨¨ à¨…à¨¤à©‡ à¨¸à¨¼à¨¾à¨®à¨² à¨¬à©±à¨²à©‡à¨¬à¨¾à¨œà¨¼à¨¾à¨‚ à¨¦à©€ à¨¸à©‚à¨šà©€ à¨¦à¨¿à¨“à¥¤
query:
WITH WicketInfo AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "inning",
    "striker_id",
    "non_striker_id",
    "runs_scored",
    "extra_runs",
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN "player_out_id" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (
      PARTITION BY "match_id", "inning"
      ORDER BY "over_number", "ball_number"
      ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING
    ), 0) AS "partnership_group"
  FROM "Deliveries"
  WHERE "batting_team" = 'Rajasthan Royals'
),
PartnershipRuns AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "inning",
    "partnership_group",
    SUM("runs_scored" + "extra_runs") AS "partnership_runs"
  FROM WicketInfo
  WHERE "partnership_group" >= 5
  GROUP BY
    "match_id",
    "inning",
    "partnership_group"
),
PartnershipPlayers AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "inning",
    "partnership_group",
    "player_id"
  FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT "match_id", "inning", "partnership_group", "striker_id" AS "player_id" FROM WicketInfo
    UNION
    SELECT DISTINCT "match_id", "inning", "partnership_group", "non_striker_id" AS "player_id" FROM WicketInfo
  )
  WHERE "partnership_group" >= 5
),
PartnershipBatters AS (
  SELECT
    T1."match_id",
    T1."inning",
    T1."partnership_group",
    GROUP_CONCAT(T2."player_name", ', ') AS "batters"
  FROM PartnershipPlayers AS T1
  JOIN "Players" AS T2 ON T1."player_id" = T2."player_id"
  GROUP BY
    T1."match_id",
    T1."inning",
    T1."partnership_group"
)
SELECT
  T1."partnership_runs",
  T2."batters"
FROM PartnershipRuns AS T1
JOIN PartnershipBatters AS T2
  ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id"
  AND T1."inning" = T2."inning"
  AND T1."partnership_group" = T2."partnership_group"
ORDER BY
  T1."partnership_runs" DESC
LIMIT 2;

WITH PartnershipCTE AS (
    SELECT 
        d.match_id,
        d.inning,
        d.striker_id,
        d.non_striker_id,
        SUM(d.runs_scored) AS partnership_runs,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY d.match_id, d.inning ORDER BY SUM(d.runs_scored) DESC) AS wicket_fall
    FROM Deliveries d
    JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id
    WHERE m.team1 = 'RR' OR m.team2 = 'RR'
    GROUP BY d.match_id, d.inning, d.striker_id, d.non_striker_id
),
FilteredPartnerships AS (
    SELECT 
        p.match_id,
        p.inning,
        p.striker_id,
        p.non_striker_id,
        p.partnership_runs
    FROM PartnershipCTE p
    WHERE p.wicket_fall <= 6
),
RankedPartnerships AS (
    SELECT 
        fp.match_id,
        fp.inning,
        fp.striker_id,
        fp.non_striker_id,
        fp.partnership_runs,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY fp.partnership_runs DESC) AS rn
    FROM FilteredPartnerships fp
)
SELECT 
    rp.partnership_runs,
    p1.player_name AS player1,
    p2.player_name AS player2
FROM RankedPartnerships rp
JOIN Players p1 ON rp.striker_id = p1.player_id
JOIN Players p2 ON rp.non_striker_id = p2.player_id
WHERE rp.rn <= 2;

query: WITH PlayerInnings AS (SELECT "match_id", "striker_id", "batting_team", SUM("runs_scored") OVER (PARTITION BY "match_id", "striker_id" ORDER BY "inning", "over_number", "ball_number") AS "cumulative_runs", SUM(CASE WHEN "wides" = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY "match_id", "striker_id" ORDER BY "inning", "over_number", "ball_number") AS "balls_faced" FROM "Deliveries"), FiftyData AS (SELECT "match_id", "striker_id", "batting_team", MIN("balls_faced") AS "balls_to_reach_50" FROM PlayerInnings WHERE "cumulative_runs" >= 50 GROUP BY "match_id", "striker_id") SELECT T3."player_name", T2."batting_team", T4."season", T2."balls_to_reach_50" FROM FiftyData AS T2 INNER JOIN "Players" AS T3 ON T2."striker_id" = T3."player_id" INNER JOIN "Matches" AS T4 ON T2."match_id" = T4."match_id" ORDER BY T2."balls_to_reach_50" ASC LIMIT 4

FROM

WITH OpenerInnings AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    "match_id",
    "inning",
    "striker_id" AS "player_id"
  FROM "Deliveries"
  WHERE
    "over_number" = 0
  UNION
  SELECT DISTINCT
    "match_id",
    "inning",
    "non_striker_id" AS "player_id"
  FROM "Deliveries"
  WHERE
    "over_number" = 0
), OpenerScores AS (
  SELECT
    T1."player_id",
    T2."match_id",
    T3."match_date",
    T3."season",
    T2."batting_team",
    SUM(T2."runs_scored") AS "runs"
  FROM OpenerInnings AS T1
  INNER JOIN "Deliveries" AS T2
    ON T1."player_id" = T2."striker_id"
    AND T1."match_id" = T2."match_id"
    AND T1."inning" = T2."inning"
  INNER JOIN "Matches" AS T3
    ON T1."match_id" = T3."match_id"
  GROUP BY
    T1."player_id",
    T2."match_id"
), RankedScores AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "player_id" ORDER BY "match_date") AS inning_rank
  FROM OpenerScores
), StreakIdentifier AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    inning_rank - ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "player_id" ORDER BY "match_date") AS streak_group
  FROM RankedScores
  WHERE
    "runs" >= 50
), StreakDetails AS (
  SELECT
    "player_id",
    COUNT(*) AS "streak_count",
    GROUP_CONCAT("runs", ', ') AS "scores",
    GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT "batting_team") AS "teams",
    GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT SUBSTR("season", 1, 4)) AS "years"
  FROM StreakIdentifier
  GROUP BY
    "player_id",
    "streak_group"
), MaxStreak AS (
  SELECT
    MAX("streak_count") AS max_streak
  FROM StreakDetails
)

        COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY f.striker_id ORDER BY f.match_id, f.inning ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) - 
        COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY f.striker_id, f.match_id, f.inning ORDER BY f.match_id, f.inning ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS grp
    FROM Fifties f
),
StreakGroups AS (
    SELECT
        s.striker_id,
        s.player_name,
        s.team_name,
        s.season,
        s.score,
        s.match_id,
        s.inning,
        s.grp,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY s.striker_id, s.grp ORDER BY s.match_id, s.inning) AS streak_length,
        FIRST_VALUE(s.match_id) OVER (PARTITION BY s.striker_id, s.grp ORDER BY s.match_id, s.inning) AS streak_start_match
    FROM Streaks s
),
MaxStreaks AS (
    SELECT
        sg.striker_id,
        sg.player_name,
        sg.team_name,
        sg.season,
        sg.score,
        sg.streak_length,
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY sg.streak_length DESC) AS rank_by_streak
    FROM StreakGroups sg
)
SELECT
    ms.player_name,
    ms.streak_length,
    ms.score,
    ms.team_name,
    ms.season
FROM MaxStreaks ms
WHERE ms.rank_by_streak = 1
ORDER BY ms.player_name, ms.season;

question: RCB à°•à°¿ à°µà±à°¯à°¤à°¿à°°à±‡à°•à°‚à°—à°¾ CSK à°¯à±Šà°•à±à°• à°…à°¨à±à°¨à°¿à°Ÿà°¿à°•à°¨à±à°¨à°¾ à°ªà±†à°¦à±à°¦ à°­à°¾à°—à°¸à±à°µà°¾à°®à±à°¯à°‚ (à° à°µà°¿à°•à±†à°Ÿà± à°•à°¿ à°…à°¯à±à°¯à°¿à°¨) à°à°®à°¿à°Ÿà°¿?
query:
WITH MatchIDs AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id"
  FROM "Matches"
  WHERE
    (
      CASE "team1"
        WHEN 'Royal Challengers Bangalore' THEN 'Royal Challengers Bengaluru'
        ELSE "team1"
      END = 'Royal Challengers Bengaluru' AND "team2" = 'Chennai Super Kings'
    ) OR (
      "team1" = 'Chennai Super Kings' AND CASE "team2"
        WHEN 'Royal Challengers Bangalore' THEN 'Royal Challengers Bengaluru'
        ELSE "team2"
      END = 'Royal Challengers Bengaluru'
    )
), PartnershipPeriods AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "inning",
    "over_number",
    "ball_number",
    "striker_id",
    "non_striker_id",
    "runs_scored",
    "extra_runs",
    SUM(CASE WHEN "player_out_id" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY "match_id", "inning" ORDER BY "over_number", "ball_number") AS "partnership_group"
  FROM "Deliveries"
  WHERE
    "match_id" IN (
      SELECT
        "match_id"
      FROM MatchIDs
    )
), PartnershipDetails AS (
  SELECT
    "partnership_group",
    "match_id",
    CASE WHEN "striker_id" < "non_striker_id" THEN "striker_id" ELSE "non_striker_id" END AS "p1_id",
    CASE WHEN "striker_id" < "non_striker_id" THEN "non_striker_id" ELSE "striker_id" END AS "p2_id",
    SUM("runs_scored" + "extra_runs") AS "runs"
  FROM PartnershipPeriods
  GROUP BY
    "match_id",
    "inning",
    "partnership_group",
    "p1_id",
    "p2_id"
)
SELECT
  T3."player_name",
  T4."player_name",
  T2."runs"
FROM PartnershipDetails AS T2
JOIN "Players" AS T3
  ON T2."p1_id" = T3."player_id"
JOIN "Players" AS T4
  ON T2."p2_id" = T4."player_id"
ORDER BY
  T2."runs" DESC
LIMIT 1;

question: IPL à¨µà¨¿à©±à¨š RCB à¨²à¨ˆ à¨²à¨—à¨¾à¨¤à¨¾à¨° à¨¸à¨­ à¨¤à©‹à¨‚ à¨µà©±à¨§ 50+ à¨¸à¨•à©‹à¨° à¨¬à¨£à¨¾à¨‰à¨£ à¨¦à©‡ à¨¸à¨¾à¨°à©‡ à¨®à©Œà¨•à¨¿à¨†à¨‚ à¨¦à¨¾ à¨µà©‡à¨°à¨µà¨¾à¥¤

WITH PlayerMatchScores AS (
  SELECT
    T1.striker_id,
    T2.match_date,
    SUM(T1.runs_scored) AS runs
  FROM Deliveries AS T1
  INNER JOIN Matches AS T2
    ON T1.match_id = T2.match_id
  WHERE
    (CASE
      WHEN T1.batting_team IN ('Royal Challengers Bangalore', 'Royal Challengers Bengaluru') THEN 'Royal Challengers Bengaluru'
      ELSE T1.batting_team
    END) = 'Royal Challengers Bengaluru'
  GROUP BY
    T1.striker_id,
    T2.match_date
), FiftyPlusFlag AS (
  SELECT
    striker_id,
    match_date,
    (
      CASE
        WHEN runs >= 50
        THEN 1
        ELSE 0
      END
    ) AS is_fifty_plus,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY striker_id ORDER BY match_date) AS match_num
  FROM PlayerMatchScores
), StreakGroup AS (
  SELECT
    striker_id,
    (
      match_num - ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY striker_id ORDER BY match_date)
    ) AS streak_id
  FROM FiftyPlusFlag
  WHERE
    is_fifty_plus = 1
)
SELECT
  T2.player_name,
  COUNT(T1.striker_id) AS consecutive_fifties
FROM StreakGroup AS T1
INNER JOIN Players AS T2
  ON T1.striker_id = T2.player_id
GROUP BY
  T2.player_name,
  T1.streak_id
ORDER BY
  consecutive_fifties DESC
LIMIT 1;

question: 4 fasteest to reach 4000 runs in terms of balls played

WITH CumulativeData AS (
  SELECT
    T1."striker_id",
    SUM(T1."runs_scored") OVER (PARTITION BY T1."striker_id" ORDER BY T2."match_date", T1."delivery_id") AS "cumulative_runs",
    SUM(CASE WHEN T1."wides" = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY T1."striker_id" ORDER BY T2."match_date", T1."delivery_id") AS "cumulative_balls"
  FROM Deliveries AS T1
  INNER JOIN Matches AS T2
    ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id"
), MilestoneReached AS (
  SELECT
    "striker_id",
    MIN("cumulative_balls") AS "balls_to_4000"
  FROM CumulativeData
  WHERE
    "cumulative_runs" >= 4000
  GROUP BY
    "striker_id"
)
SELECT
  T3."player_name",
  T4."balls_to_4000"
FROM MilestoneReached AS T4
INNER JOIN Players AS T3
  ON T4."striker_id" = T3."player_id"
ORDER BY
  T4."balls_to_4000"
LIMIT 4;

WITH CumulativeData AS (
  SELECT
    T1."striker_id",
    SUM(T1."runs_scored") OVER (PARTITION BY T1."striker_id" ORDER BY T2."match_date", T1."delivery_id") AS "cumulative_runs",
    SUM(CASE WHEN T1."wides" = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY T1."striker_id" ORDER BY T2."match_date", T1."delivery_id") AS "cumulative_balls"
  FROM Deliveries AS T1
  INNER JOIN Matches AS T2
    ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id"
), MilestoneReached AS (
  SELECT
    "striker_id",
    MIN("cumulative_balls") AS "balls_to_4000"
  FROM CumulativeData
  WHERE
    "cumulative_runs" >= 4000
  GROUP BY
    "striker_id"
)
SELECT
  T3."player_name",
  T4."balls_to_4000"
FROM MilestoneReached AS T4
INNER JOIN Players AS T3
  ON T4."striker_id" = T3."player_id"
ORDER BY
  T4."balls_to_4000"
LIMIT 4;
generated_sql:
SELECT p.player_name
FROM Players p
JOIN (
    SELECT d.striker_id, SUM(d.runs_scored) as total_runs, COUNT(*) as balls_faced
    FROM Deliveries d
    GROUP BY d.striker_id
    HAVING total_runs >= 4000
    ORDER BY balls_faced ASC
    LIMIT 4
) AS top_players ON p.player_id = top_players.striker_id;

query:
SELECT
  T1.batting_team,
  T2.season,
  SUM(CASE WHEN T1.runs_scored = 0 AND T1.wides = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dot_balls
FROM Deliveries AS T1
INNER JOIN Matches AS T2
  ON T1.match_id = T2.match_id
GROUP BY
  T1.match_id,
  T1.inning
HAVING
  MAX(T1.over_number) = 19
ORDER BY
  dot_balls ASC
LIMIT 6;
generated_sql:
SELECT 
    m.match_id,
    d.batting_team,
    COUNT(*) AS dot_balls
FROM 
    Deliveries d
JOIN 
    Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id
WHERE 
    d.runs_scored = 0
    AND d.extra_runs = 0
    AND d.inning IN (1, 2)
GROUP BY 
    m.match_id, d.batting_team
HAVING 
    COUNT(*) = (
        SELECT MIN(dot_count) 
        FROM (
            SELECT COUNT(*) AS dot_count
            FROM Deliveries d2
            JOIN Matches m2 ON d2.match_id = m2.match_id
            WHERE d2.runs_scored = 0 AND d2.extra_runs = 0 AND d2.inning IN (1, 2)
            GROUP BY d2.match_id, d2.batting_team
        )
    )
LIMIT 6;

WITH BatterScores AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",

  FROM "Deliveries"

question: à¨–à©‡à¨¡à©€à¨†à¨‚ à¨—à¨ˆà¨†à¨‚ à¨—à©‡à¨‚à¨¦à¨¾à¨‚ à¨¦à©‡ à¨…à¨§à¨¾à¨° 'à¨¤à©‡ 4000 à¨°à¨¨ à¨¤à©±à¨• à¨ªà¨¹à©à©°à¨šà¨£ à¨µà¨¾à¨²à©‡ 4 à¨¸à¨­ à¨¤à©‹à¨‚ à¨¤à©‡à¨œà¨¼ à¨¬à©±à¨²à©‡à¨¬à¨¾à¨œà¨¼à¥¤

WITH CumulativeData AS (
  SELECT
    T1."striker_id",
    SUM(T1."runs_scored") OVER (PARTITION BY T1."striker_id" ORDER BY T2."match_date", T1."delivery_id") AS "cumulative_runs",
    SUM(CASE WHEN T1."wides" = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY T1."striker_id" ORDER BY T2."match_date", T1."delivery_id") AS "cumulative_balls"
  FROM Deliveries AS T1
  INNER JOIN Matches AS T2
    ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id"
), MilestoneReached AS (
  SELECT
    "striker_id",
    MIN("cumulative_balls") AS "balls_to_4000"
  FROM CumulativeData
  WHERE
    "cumulative_runs" >= 4000
  GROUP BY
    "striker_id"
)
SELECT
  T3."player_name",
  T4."balls_to_4000"
FROM MilestoneReached AS T4
INNER JOIN Players AS T3
  ON T4."striker_id" = T3."player_id"
ORDER BY
  T4."balls_to_4000"
LIMIT 4;

        p.player_id,
        p.player_name,
        SUM(d.runs_scored) AS total_runs,
        COUNT(d.delivery_id) AS balls_faced
    FROM Players p
    JOIN Deliveries d ON p.player_id = d.striker_id
    GROUP BY p.player_id, p.player_name
),
CumulativeRuns AS (
    SELECT
        player_id,
        player_name,
        total_runs,
        balls_faced,
        SUM(total_runs) OVER (PARTITION BY player_id ORDER BY balls_faced) AS cumulative_runs,
        SUM(balls_faced) OVER (PARTITION BY player_id ORDER BY balls_faced) AS cumulative_balls
    FROM PlayerRunsAndBalls
),
PlayersWith4000 AS (
    SELECT
        player_id,
        player_name,
        MIN(cumulative_balls) AS balls_to_reach_4000
    FROM CumulativeRuns
    WHERE cumulative_runs >= 4000
    GROUP BY player_id, player_name
)
SELECT
    player_name
FROM PlayersWith4000
ORDER BY balls_to_reach_4000 ASC
LIMIT 4;

question: highest partnership for any wicket for Rajasthan Royals.give the runs and players involved opposition and the year
query:
WITH PartnershipDetails AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "inning",
    "striker_id",
    "non_striker_id",
    "runs_scored",
    "extra_runs",
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN "wicket_type" IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (
      PARTITION BY "match_id", "inning"
      ORDER BY "over_number", "ball_number"
      ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING
    ), 0) AS partnership_group_id
  FROM "Deliveries"
  WHERE "batting_team" = 'Rajasthan Royals'
),
PartnershipRuns AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "inning",
    "partnership_group_id",
    SUM("runs_scored" + "extra_runs") AS total_runs
  FROM PartnershipDetails
  GROUP BY "match_id", "inning", "partnership_group_id"
),
PartnershipPlayers AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "inning",
    "partnership_group_id",
    "player_id"
  FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT "match_id", "inning", "partnership_group_id", "striker_id" AS player_id FROM PartnershipDetails
    UNION
    SELECT DISTINCT "match_id", "inning", "partnership_group_id", "non_striker_id" AS player_id FROM PartnershipDetails
  )
),
FullPartnerships AS (
  SELECT
    pr."match_id",
    pr.total_runs,
    GROUP_CONCAT(p."player_name", ', ') AS players
  FROM PartnershipRuns AS pr
  JOIN PartnershipPlayers AS pp
    ON pr."match_id" = pp."match_id"
    AND pr."inning" = pp."inning"
    AND pr."partnership_group_id" = pp."partnership_group_id"
  JOIN "Players" AS p
    ON pp.player_id = p."player_id"
  GROUP BY
    pr."match_id",
    pr."inning",
    pr."partnership_group_id",
    pr.total_runs
  HAVING COUNT(pp.player_id) >= 2
)
SELECT
  fp.total_runs AS "runs",
  fp.players AS "players_involved",
  CASE
    WHEN m."team1" = 'Rajasthan Royals' THEN m."team2"
    ELSE m."team1"
  END AS "opposition",
  m."season" AS "year"
FROM FullPartnerships AS fp
JOIN "Matches" AS m
  ON fp."match_id" = m."match_id"
ORDER BY
  fp.total_runs DESC
LIMIT 1;

question: 4 Fastest IPL 100s (by balls).give the player runs self and opposition team city and year

    "match_id"
  HAVING
    SUM("runs_scored") >= 100
), CumulativeInnings AS (
  SELECT
    T1."match_id",
    T1."striker_id",
    T1."bowling_team",
    SUM(T1."runs_scored") OVER (PARTITION BY T1."match_id", T1."striker_id" ORDER BY T1."over_number", T1."ball_number") AS cumulative_runs,
    SUM(CASE WHEN T1."wides" = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY T1."match_id", T1."striker_id" ORDER BY T1."over_number", T1."ball_number") AS balls_faced
  FROM "Deliveries" AS T1
  INNER JOIN PlayerInnings AS T2
    ON T1."match_id" = T2."match_id" AND T1."striker_id" = T2."striker_id"
), BallsTo100 AS (
  SELECT
    "match_id",
    "striker_id",
    "bowling_team",
    balls_faced,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY "match_id", "striker_id" ORDER BY balls_faced) AS rn
  FROM CumulativeInnings

    cumulative_runs >= 100
)
SELECT
